title: Solid Core vs. Cellular Core PVC Drainage Pipes
description: Selection of PVC pipe materials significantly impacts drainage system performance, structural strength, and sound transmission. Solid core PVC is manufactured with homogeneous plastic throughout its wall thickness, offering higher structural rigidity and impact resistance for exposed or underground installations. Cellular core PVC features a lightweight density core sandwiched between solid outer layers, making it easier to cut and install at lower material costs. While both meet standard DWV requirements, solid core is preferred for underground piping under load or where acoustic reduction is desired.

Solid Core vs. Cellular Core PVC Drainage Pipes

Selection of PVC pipe materials significantly impacts drainage system performance, structural strength, and sound transmission. Solid core PVC is manufactured with homogeneous plastic throughout its wall thickness, offering higher structural rigidity and impact resistance for exposed or underground installations. Cellular core PVC features a lightweight density core sandwiched between solid outer layers, making it easier to cut and install at lower material costs. While both meet standard DWV requirements, solid core is preferred for underground piping under load or where acoustic reduction is desired.
